environment: authorized development Supabase and local real Next.js application
historyWindowDecision: Each read returns the 64 oldest chronological events, uses a SQL-side 65th-row probe, preserves all retained evidence, and reports hasMore when newer events remain instead of materializing an unbounded response.
requiredObservations: reviewer reads original, every saved edit, author withdrawal and moderated removal evidence
author and moderated removal labels remain distinct and only moderation carries a reason
archived-property and inactive-author attribution remain readable to a live reviewer
ordinary, staff, author, anonymous, inactive and unlinked bypasses return no retained payload
history over the SQL window returns the 64 oldest events with hasMore true, identifies newer events as omitted, and keeps an honest UI notice
VI/EN rendering preserves source text and localizes event labels, reasons, failures and window notices
reviewer demotion or deactivation clears displayed history on refocus
edit/removal/archive races retain only the serialized committed outcome
limits: No hosted run or production acceptance is claimed by this artifact.
Fixture manifest, operator credentials and customer data remain outside Git.
